records.name: 1737, Need to talk?
records.what: New Zealand's national mental health and addictions line. Free call or text 1737 any time to reach a trained counsellor, or choose to talk with a peer support worker.
records.start: Call or text 1737. In an emergency, call 111.

records.name: Te Kāhui Māngai: directory of iwi and Māori organisations
records.what: The government directory of iwi, hapū and marae, with the organizations that represent them and how to reach them.
records.who: Anyone, including people reconnecting with their iwi, hapū or marae.
records.start: Search for your iwi or marae, or browse by region.

records.name: Whānau Ora
records.what: Navigators (kaiārahi) with local and cultural knowledge help whānau plan, get through a crisis, and connect with the support they need to reach their goals.
records.start: Contact a Whānau Ora commissioning agency or provider in your region, or your local Te Puni Kōkiri office.
